notes: Wallpaper now runs full-bleed: the image extends under the status and navigation bars, so the short bars at the top and bottom are gone, and its framing matches the system wallpaper exactly — app-to-home transitions no longer crossfade between two crops. The decoded wallpaper is also cached, so returning home no longer re-decodes it mid-transition. The Lens socket is now silicone: a thicker, matte gasket dyed from the wallpaper's own color, with soft wrap shading, a wide gentle well and only a faint satin lift — no machined rim, no gloss. Background's screen switch, palette and diagnostics now render live every time the page opens, so the Cover / Main switch can no longer be hidden by a stale page.
